title: Clinical SOAP Note Writer
description: Converts raw clinical encounter notes into a fully structured SOAP note with Assessment and Plan sections.

title: Differential Diagnosis Assistant
description: Generates a ranked differential diagnosis list from a clinical presentation, with supporting reasoning and red-flag alerts.

title: Patient Education Explainer
description: Translates a clinical diagnosis, procedure, or medication into clear patient education material at a 6th–8th grade reading level.

title: Prior Authorization Letter Writer
description: Drafts a compelling, evidence-based prior authorization letter to an insurance payer for medications, procedures, or diagnostic tests.

title: Hospital Discharge Summary Generator
description: Generates a complete hospital discharge summary from admission and progress notes, formatted for the primary care provider handoff.
